en: You're about to wear yourself out pining for them. Try changing things up a little and give yourself a break.

context: Nana: The World, reversed, position: the people around you
jp:
ふたりとは
カンケイないトコロで『しょうがい』が、
 おきてしまいそう!ふたりのキョゥツゥの友人がケンカするカモ?
en: Trouble is brewing somewhere that has nothing to do with the two of you! Maybe a fight between your mutual friends?

context: Nana: The World, reversed, position: love charms and goods
jp:
ラッキーファッション!『みどり』いろを
  ちゅうしんに
コーディネイトするか、『したぎ』に『みどり』のリボンをつける。
en: Lucky fashion! Build your outfit around the color green, or tie a green ribbon onto your underwear.

context: Nana: The World, reversed, position: where the love is heading
jp:
このまま
『あなた』から
なにも『こうどう』を  オコサなければ、『こい』はシゼンに
おわってしまうカモ。
en: If you keep on like this and don't take any action yourself, this love might just quietly come to an end on its own.
